text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"—Not only in the race itself, but thanks 
to everyone's support... I was able to 
give it everything I had! The cheers I'm 
getting keep growing bit by bit."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"And... get this! Even the famous City-san 
was watching my race! She even told me 
that I ran with a lot of poise!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"But right after... they asked me 
questions like, 'How were you able to run 
so boldly?' ...Something felt kind of 
different..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"She's deep in thought precisely because 
she's an amazing Umamusume. I need to 
focus on worrying about myself!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"My next goal is the Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup! Hishi Ama-san, who's always lookin' 
out for me, might run too, so I gotta pump 
myself up and give it everything!"
